r4_boundary.failure_reason: extension/plugin load is absent from runtime attestation

failure_coordinate.predicate: exact physical realpath of extension and plugin must each appear in h0_runtime_inputs_v1.regular_files with build_artifact binding, matching length/sha256, and kernel-observed consuming operations

root_causes.summary: Recorder required declared logical-path aliases and rejected non-canonical loader paths even when the resolved physical realpath was an admitted plan member (symlink forms under uv base_prefix; .. components in dynamic-linker paths).
Frozen tool_runtime did not admit the CPython base_prefix stdlib / host startup files required for confined -I -B -c extension load.
Static ldd closure omitted runtime-dlopened siblings (e.g. libtbbmalloc for libtbb), so Landlock/recorder rejected legitimate loads.
Qualification extension_load only checked subprocess return code and did not share the controller attestation membership predicate.

repairs: observe_path membership key = resolved physical realpath (admitted plan member)
recursive ldd + known dlopen siblings + maps-observed shared objects in build identity
qualification confined extension/plugin load with same membership predicate
forbidden_repairs_not_used: remove or weaken controller membership check
copy expected artifacts into regular_files without observing them
treat build_identity membership as runtime observation
hard-code the two paths into a successful attestation
turn attestation failure into a warning
